document_summary: Berkeley Rent Board news notice announcing the January 1, 2026 inflation adjustment of owner move-in and Ellis Act eviction relocation assistance payments under Berkeley's Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance and Ellis Implementation Ordinance.

rules.title: Berkeley relocation assistance for owner move-in and Ellis Act evictions (2026 adjustment)
rules.requirement: Owners must pay tenants relocation assistance when evicting for owner move-in or to remove the property from the rental market under the Ellis Act; payments are indexed annually to inflation. For 2026 the standard payment is $19,413, with an additional $6,471 for qualifying households.
rules.key_value: $19,413 standard relocation payment; additional $6,471 for qualifying households (effective 2026-01-01)
rules.coverage_conditions: Tenants evicted for owner move-in (Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance) or for Ellis Act withdrawal of the property from the rental market (Ellis Implementation Ordinance).
rules.citation: Berkeley Municipal Code ch. 13.76 (Rent Stabilization and Good Cause for Eviction Ordinance); Berkeley Ellis Implementation Ordinance (BMC ch. 13.77)
rules.quoted_span: At its October 16, 2025 Special Meeting, the Rent Board approved relocation assistance payment increases that will go into effect on January 1, 2026.
rules.extraction_notes: Effective date is that of the 2026 inflation adjustment (1.5% CPI increase, approved by the Rent Board on 2025-10-16). The adoption_date is the Rent Board approval date. Amounts are adjusted annually; the document is a summary of the ordinances, whose code citations are not given in the text and are supplied from general knowledge.
